subject: reasoning
question: Seven people D, E, F, G, H, I and O are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table. Only one person sits between H and O when counted from the left of O. I sits third to the right of D. F sits third to the left of E. I sits to the immediate right of F. G is not an immediate neighbour of F. How many people sit between G and O when counted from the right of G?
solution:
Seven people D, E, F, G, H, I and O are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table.

 
• Only one person sits between H and O when counted from the left of O.
 
• I sits third to the right of D.
 
• F sits third to the left of E.
 
• I sits to the immediate right of F.
 
• G is not an immediate neighbour of F.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
